# Colour grade before and after on the talking-head edit

The warm-vibrant grade preset on the talking-head edit, shown as a split screen: the left half is the source, the right half the graded file, so the extra contrast, saturation and warmth are visible on the same frame.

- Type: Colour grade
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `grade`
- Output: 1920x1080, 7 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f04-color-grade.mp4`](../videos/f04-color-grade.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Grade 7 seconds of ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 (from 2.5 s to 9.5 s) with the warm-vibrant preset, so it feels warmer and punchier for a promo. Then make a before/after split for the client: left half the original, right half the graded clip, a thin cream divider in the middle and small "Before" and "After: warm-vibrant" labels in Geist from fonts/ (labels.svg). Keep the audio.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f04-color-grade
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f04-color-grade/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 2.5 -t 7 -i ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/source.mp4
mgvideo grade work/source.mp4 --preset warm-vibrant --out work/graded.mp4
node rasterize.mjs labels.svg work/labels.png 1920 1080
ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -i work/graded.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v]crop=960:1080:0:0[l];[1:v]crop=960:1080:960:0[r];[l][r]hstack=inputs=2,drawbox=x=958:y=0:w=4:h=1080:color=0xf0eadf:t=fill[c];[c][2:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/compare.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/compare.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
